assessments.reasoning: The manual explicitly says each VariableToValue right-side value is evaluated before any is stored and illustrates reading the old first target value in the other expression.

challenge.method: Independently recalculate the manual example from its declared initial value and contrast pre-storage evaluation with sequential write-and-evaluate behavior.
challenge.results: The prior value is five, so the second expression yields four. A sequential update to the first target would instead produce one. The manual labels the documented behavior current and potentially subject to change.

limitations: The evidence is documentary for 3.3.8 and leaves right-side order, later write order and transactionality untested.
